steps.title: Comms stable in Service Inspection?

steps.title: Replace door switch

steps.body: Step 1/4/6: drain pump cycles (14 s on / 2 s off pattern). 5C if pump stuck or not draining.

steps.title: Dry fan motor coil

steps.body: Step 5: auto door actuator runs; fan 30 s. FC if fan <3000 RPM; dC3 if door not sensed open after retry.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Step 5: auto door actuator runs; fan 30 s. FC if fan <3000 RPM; dC3 if door not sensed open after retry.

steps.title: Water fills in Smart Install step 2?
steps.body: Auto step 2 supplies 4.5 L. 4C if pulses <10 in 20 s or level not reached in 5 min (inspection) / 60 min (normal).
steps.sourceExcerpt: Auto step 2 supplies 4.5 L. 4C if pulses <10 in 20 s or level not reached in 5 min (inspection) / 60 min (normal).

steps.body: Replace case brake or flow meter when pulse detection fails.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Power off. Measure between heater terminals (or heater relay red to power relay black/yellow). Normal: 12.14–14.16 Ω.

steps.title: Heater heats in Smart Install step 3?
steps.body: Manual step 3: C-pump 10 s then heater. Temperature should rise ≥2°C or reach 73°C; HC1 if no rise in 10 min.
steps.sourceExcerpt: Manual step 3: C-pump 10 s then heater. Temperature should rise ≥2°C or reach 73°C; HC1 if no rise in 10 min.

steps.body: CN503 pin 2 leakage input: LC when ≤3 V for 3 s. After 3 min drain, sensor should read >3 V if dry.
steps.sourceExcerpt: CN503 pin 2 leakage input: LC when ≤3 V for 3 s. After 3 min drain, sensor should read >3 V if dry.

steps.body: No active leak; sensor dry. Replace main PBA only if leak repaired but LC persists.

steps.title: Overflow sensor >3 V when tub empty?

steps.sourceExcerpt: CN503 pin 1 overflow: OC when ≤3 V for 5 s. Should read >3 V when tub empty after drain.

steps.title: Inlet valve stuck open?

steps.sourceExcerpt: Check water valve shuts off; case brake/flow meter not falsely indicating fill (4C5).

steps.title: Replace valve or case brake
steps.body: Replace inlet valve or case brake/flow meter when OC persists with empty tub.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Reseat Sub PBA, Touch PBA, CN101, and CN802 main-to-sub connectors. Check for condensation on CN103 and CON100.

steps.sourceExcerpt: Measure CN402 pin 7 to pin 2 on main PBA. Door open or before cycle: ~1 V. After door closed and cycle started: 10.5–13 V.

steps.sourceExcerpt: White wire door switch: OFF when door open, ON when closed. Faulty door switch blocks Power and Heater relays.

steps.sourceExcerpt: With power on, measure voltage across thermistor at CN503 pin 4. Normal: 0.05–4.95 V.
